environment.description: Application deployed on EC2 behind an NLB (Network Load Balancer, Layer 4) with no additional request inspection. Traffic passes directly to the Flask application on port 8080. Security groups allow inbound TCP/8080 from the NLB target group. No web application firewall or request filtering is configured. The application uses SQLite 3.39 which supports stacked queries.

config.network: sg-0a1b2c3d allows TCP/8080 from NLB subnet
